title: ZIA proxy modes: explicit and transparent
aliases: how does zia identify the destination

prose.text: "How does ZIA know where this connection is going?" depends on how the traffic arrived.

steps.label: Did the client send it to the service as a proxy?
steps.text: Then the CONNECT request names the host before TLS: [[zia.proxy-mode.explicit]].

steps.label: Was it redirected without the client knowing?
steps.text: Then the host comes from SNI, or the server certificate when SNI is absent: [[zia.proxy-mode.transparent]].

steps.label: Which one is this flow?
steps.text: The forwarding method does not settle it (a tunnel can carry PAC traffic): [[zia.proxy-mode.forwarding-map]].

prose.text: What the mode changes in policy is held by the SSL Inspection subjects, not here: first-pass evaluation on the CONNECT host or SNI ([[zia.ssl-inspection.pipeline]]) and the criteria that exist in one mode only ([[zia.ssl-inspection.criteria]]). How traffic gets to the service in the first place is [[zia.traffic-forwarding]].
